name: SCCW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's rankings of 22 July 2009 list this title as To Be Determined; Myke Adams, the Bunkhouse Brawl winner, was its newly crowned champion by 10 August and stood first in the ten of 12 August.

name: All Barrie Championship
epitaph: Riflewilly was listed as champion on 22 July 2009; Sydney LaRoux took the title from him on 27 July and was still champion on 12 August.

name: All Barrie Tag Team Championship
epitaph: War Machine were the All Barrie tag champions on 10 August 2009, and the 12 August news calls its announced main event the first match since they won the titles.

name: BARBARIC Championship
epitaph: Jay Jerzey held the Barbaric title on 10 August 2009 after what the fed called the most bloody and brutal match in its history, and was announced to defend it against Rex Masters on 17 August.
